messages:
jenna: Heads up — change window starting in 30m for v2.4.0 canary. CI is spiking, deploy-bot blocked on promote. Anyone seeing same? :eyes:

sam: seeing long queue on `ci/integration-e2e-aws` — jobs stuck in runner pending

deploy-bot: promotion blocked: cannot acquire artifact artifact-store/v2.4.0-2026-03-20@sha256:8f4a2b... ; blocking job ci/promotion-guard #487

karim: tests timing out in integration.order_service.* — logs show DB seed failing at ~3m repeatedly

priya: agree, reproduce locally with `pytest tests/integration/test_order.py::test_order_flow -k dbseed` — fails intermittently

lia: we also saw heavy runner reuse; ephemeral-runner pool down to 2/8 due to quota bump in eu-west

sam: ops, can we scale runners? @ops-qa

release-lead: decision time — either delay window, pin to previous artifact, or roll forward with limited routes. What's risk if we pin back to v2.3.9?

karim: pin reduces risk; v2.3.9 passed canary last night. We'd lose the v2.4 features but keep stability.

priya: alternative — rerun failed jobs with `--shard 4` and disable the flaky seed test for canary only (skip via env var). That gets canary out and we can debug post-rollout.

jenna: prefer pin + hotfix for v2.4 flake. We need to notify PM and change window owners. @pm-ops

deploy-bot: CI rerun requested by sam: ci/integration-e2e-aws #212 -> started. -> runner=eu-west-3-small

sam: rerun looks queued, ETA ~7m

lia: increased ephemeral-runner quota for 30m, +4 runners

priya: rerun failed again — same `DB seed timeout after 180s` in order_service.

karim: could be test data collision. There's a recent migration in the PR that mutates global sequences. Suggest reverting that migration in the canary build.

jenna: ok plan: 1) abort promotion, 2) pin deployment to v2.3.9 for change window, 3) open follow-up to revert migration and run isolated queue to repro. Everyone ok? :thumbsup:

release-lead: +1. @deploy-bot please hold promotions and set release-note: "rollback to v2.3.9 due to CI integration flake". Also notify customers in ch-change-windows.

deploy-bot: Promotion held. Promotion tag set to v2.3.9. Release note posted to ch-change-windows. Ticket: RH-3421

jenna: Thanks — I'll draft the follow-up issue and assign to karim/priya. We'll target a hotfix deploy next change window.

karim: will reproduce locally, capture seed logs, and try deterministic seed. I'll post findings in this thread.

sam: tl;dr: hold rollout, pin to prior artifact, scale runners to debug, follow-up fix in work

jenna: closing for now — re-open if promotion unblocked. :white_check_mark:
